note: The shape of one row of profiles[] in qa-factory/config.json, with a row of implementation_repos[] and one of managed_dependencies[] that name it. `commands` is an OBJECT keyed by command name (`one_test` runs ONE test file, `suite` runs the whole suite), never a list; each command is {kind, scope, argv, cwd}, `argv` is an array of words, and a word that is only <placeholder> is filled in by the factory. A command whose report is junit-xml or trx holds `{report_path}` in exactly ONE place, so the factory reads the report from a file of its own: in one word of `argv`, or, for a runner that names its report file by a variable, in one value of the optional `env` (an object of variable name to exactly `{report_path}`; the factory sets those variables for that command only). `adapter_capabilities` below is a top-level key of the configuration (not of the profile): for each `adapter_id` the capabilities its tests really exercise, a word of `supported_capabilities`; a profile whose adapter or capability is not there reads as not ready. A project with no test framework yet writes `profiles: []` and `implementation_repos: []` and records the deferral at phase 4. The values below are examples: use the project's own commands, paths and versions.
